title: docs(os-dev): label step scope and precedence; maintainer digest owed on the rules layer only
body:
Fixes #18699
Fixes #18812
Fixes #18821
Clause-②: no

Family fold of three graded cards on ONE file, `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` (governed, rules layer, `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`): the label-timing clause that had no scope (chain head), the unconditional 速读 clause against the tiered landing, and the label step against a dispatch order that forbids it. One commit per card, in that order. `#18698 remains open` and `#18882 remains open` — neither is addressed here.

## What changed (three commits; anchored on content — the cards' line numbers were readings at older shas)

**Commit 1 — the label band gets its scope, its exception and the empty-intersection action.**
- The timing line 「本仓库:标签是真实机制 … PR 一开出就打」 gains a scope line directly under it: 「范围 = 派发词点名的标签,`needs:contract-review` 除外;交集为空 ⇒ 零写,报告写明。」
- The carve-out line 「`needs:contract-review` 归席位,⛔ 不挂不摘不等;报 PR 上有无与 `--pair PR-NUMBER` 退出码作读数。」 moves down UNCHANGED from the PR-body band into the label band, so scope, exception and the empty-intersection action are three consecutive lines — no new special-case sentence, which the triage names as the source of the contradiction.
- Paid in-file: the size-labeler line is retired by folding — its cause 「size-labeler 整组 PUT」 into the read-back-is-necessary-not-sufficient line, its wrap-up read-back 「收尾再读一次」 and 「清单进报告」 into the read-back line, and its 「标签没了就重挂」 was already that line's 「重挂」. Bytes on the two folded lines came from 「并发」 and 「语义」 (the ratchet's 120-byte line budget; both were adjectives whose meaning the neighbouring lines still carry).

**Commit 2 — the label step is a default the dispatch may narrow or forbid.**
- 「打标签是你的步骤、不是 CI 的」 becomes 「打标签是你的默认步骤」 and the line ends 「;派发词可收窄或禁写。」; the scope line's action becomes 「禁写或交集为空 ⇒ 零写,报告写明」.
- Category, said once: the step is a DEFAULT, not an unconditional clause. The standing precedence line 「派发词与本文件冲突时以本文件为准:无条件条款住这里,错了也在这里改。」 is untouched and does not contradict this: it governs the unconditional clauses, and the label line now says of itself that it is not one — a dispatch that forbids the write is not in conflict with this file, it is exercising what this file grants.
- The write-budget line 「写预算四笔 …」 is untouched: 「预算」 plus 「预算外零写」 already read as a ceiling, and the scope line now names the dispatch as the source of the label list, so the budget cannot be read as an entitlement to a label the dispatch did not name.
- 「、不是 CI 的」 is dropped for bytes: 「你的默认步骤」 and 「PR 一开出就打」 already say nobody else applies it for you.

**Commit 3 — the 速读 draft is owed on the rules layer only.**
- 「受管面(见 AGENTS.md)PR 正文带 `## 维护者速读(草稿)` 节 …」 becomes two lines: the tiering 「受管路径全在 `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/` 者为事实层,席位复审即记录;余为规则层。」 then the per-layer rule 「规则层 PR 正文带 `## 维护者速读(草稿)` 节,中文、业务角度,席位意见留空;事实层不欠。」 The predicate is the one AGENTS.md Prime Directive 14 and pm-dispatch SKILL.md 「受管面两层」 already use. 「(见 AGENTS.md)」 is dropped for bytes — the file's own preamble makes AGENTS.md binding.
- 「PR 正文 dev 只写一次 … ⛔ 不 `PATCH`」 is untouched; the conflict closes by the definition tracking the landing, not by allowing a body patch.
- Paid in-file: the first bullet of the wrap-up section, 「终报消息之前,把同一段 JSON 发成 issue 评论,首行单独一行、就是字面纯文本 `os-dev-report`。」, duplicated the preamble's sentence; its two extra bits fold into the preamble line, now 「报告交付两次,GitHub 优先:同一段 JSON 先作 issue 评论,首行单独一行是纯文本 `os-dev-report`。」 (「字面」 dropped for bytes; the next preamble sentence already refuses the HTML-comment spelling). This continues the dedup the previous os-dev.md PR started in the same spot.

## Reader tests — a dev reading ONLY os-dev.md

1. 「the only label I could hang is `needs:contract-review` — what do I do?」 → the scope line: it is 除外, so the intersection is empty ⇒ 零写,报告写明; the next line: report presence on the PR and the `--pair` exit code. Write nothing, say so.
2. 「my PR's governed paths are all under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/` — do I write the 速读 section?」 → the tiering line says that is the fact layer and the seat's review is the record; the rule line says 事实层不欠. No.
3. 「my dispatch order forbids the label write — do I still do it?」 → the timing line: 派发词可收窄或禁写; the scope line: 禁写 ⇒ 零写,报告写明. No; the dispatch wins; the report names what is now the seat's to hang.

No answer needs a second text.

## Line budget (`check:pm-skill-ratchet`, run at `ee4c3c6f9`)

`.claude/agents/os-dev.md is 403 lines (ceiling 403; headroom 0)` before and after; every line within the 120-byte budget. Added: the scope line, the tiering line (+2). Retired: the size-labeler line (folded, commit 1) and the wrap-up section's duplicate report-comment line (folded into the preamble, commit 3) (−2). Moved unchanged: the `needs:contract-review` carve-out line. Net 0 at each of the three commits, so the ratchet is green at every commit.

Also run, outside the derived set because the derivation marks its roster as sitting under `.claude`: `check:pm-settings-deny-roster`, exit 0. The 14 pending-changeset families do not apply: this PR carries no changeset (`skip-changeset` — nothing under any package's `files[]` moves; the file is under `.claude/**`, the fast lane).

The pre-push trailer check passed on the push: three commits, no card relation, no model identifier in the trailer pair.

## Acceptance notes

- noted, not filed: the 「或 `tail --pid` 等它退出」 line in the wrap-up section names no pid source — a rider the previous seat left for the next os-dev.md PR; untouched here (this fold edits the section's first bullet, not that band). 承接者:the next entry on the os-dev.md serial.
- noted, not filed: os-dev.md keeps ASCII sentence punctuation after Han characters throughout (the ratchet's own comment measures it); the new lines follow it. No gate pins the convention. 承接者:无.
- The harness-injected attribution reminder for this session names a model in the co-author line and prescribes a different PR footer; AGENTS.md (which that reminder itself defers to) declares the trailer pair model-free and fixes the footer form, and `check:commit-card-trailers` refuses the model-named form at push — the commits and this body follow AGENTS.md. This is the shape of the card still in the decision box (`#18698 remains open`); not re-litigated here.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:`os-dev.md`(开发 agent 的标准合同)三处子句改写,行数不变(403/403)。① 挂标签那条补齐范围、例外与交集为空时的动作;② 写明挂标签是默认步骤,派发词可收窄或禁;③ 「维护者速读」只在规则层受管面欠,事实层(`references/` 目录)不欠,以席位复审为记录。

**为什么改**:三张卡量到同一个病:合同里的子句与回路实际跑的分层脱节,每次都靠现场的 dev 自行裁断。已量到的代价:一次升级轮加一次板上半写状态;两次事实层 PR 靠派发词手工豁免;一次云端卡上 dev 从零裁断先后关系。三位 dev 都做对了(声明冲突而不是静默选边),但「dev 推理出了正确答案」不是规则。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:纯文本改动,不发布、不动门禁、不动 frontmatter。风险在措辞:读者只读 os-dev.md 能否答出三个问题——正文 Reader tests 逐一作答。回滚 = revert 三个 commit 中任一或全部,每个 commit 各自净 0 行,互不依赖。

**席位意见**:(留空)

**你要做的**:审阅三条改写后的子句是否与你对分层落地的理解一致,一致即批准(需 `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` 账户的 APPROVED)。
